standalone native Substack-uploaded video forces ordered payload segments plus a manual insertion step at recorded anchors

a Substack video-post preview/card is not a native uploaded-video block; its canonical post URL remains alone at the same source position and does not force a split
transfer wrapper for every rich-HTML segment is div dir=auto class=body markup
no visible generic manual fallback field

rendered comment cards become canonical URLs in the same source positions

all payload segments are rebuilt from the exact final archival editor body
supersession_reason: Joel's owner-final correction distinguishes nonportable native Substack-uploaded videos, which require ordered helper splits and manual insertion, from Substack video-post embeds, which remain canonical post URLs in the current payload segment without a split.
last_destination_status: Native uploaded video is owner-confirmed nonportable through the clipboard helper. Video-post URL reconstruction and every regenerated helper still require a real Opera-to-Substack destination check.

native_video_segmentation.segment_count_rule: normally native_video_count + 1; suppress empty edge segments only with explicit order retained
native_video_segmentation.segment_coverage_rule: ordered segments plus excluded native-video islands cover the editor body exactly once
